title: Plugin MCP server config (.mcp.json, .cursor-plugin/mcp.json, mcp.json)
description: The mcpServers shape shared by three generated configs. .mcp.json is Claude Code: command only, ${HOME}, no $schema and no type. .cursor-plugin/mcp.json is Cursor: command only, ${userHome} (Cursor interpolates ${userHome} and leaves ${HOME} unexpanded), no $schema and no type. mcp.json is the Agent Plugins 1.0 MCP config (GitHub Copilot CLI): $schema is https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json, type is stdio, command is node, and args carry ${PLUGIN_ROOT}. scripts/validate.js checks mcp.json against this schema and the vendored Agent Plugins MCP schema. It checks .mcp.json and .cursor-plugin/mcp.json against this schema only.

$schema.description: Present on mcp.json so the file satisfies Agent Plugins 1.0. Omitted from .mcp.json and .cursor-plugin/mcp.json.
